definitions.explanation: how to use; usage; way of using

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me how to use this machine.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous if you use it incorrectly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The usage of honorific language is difficult.

notes:
{使|つか}い{方|かた} combines the stem of ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use) with ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way, method), meaning "way of using" or "how to use."

The ~⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ pattern is highly productive:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧ (how to eat)
- ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧ (how to write)
- ⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧ (how to make)
- ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧ (how to read; pronunciation)

Common expressions:
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからない (don't know how to use)
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to learn how to use)
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{使|つか}い{方|かた} (correct usage)
